stem.text: Some extracellular protease enzymes are synthesised in an inactive form called zymogen.
Zymogen is converted to the active protease in the Golgi body.
What is the purpose of producing zymogen before converting it to the extracellular protease?

A.text: to avoid unwanted digestion of proteins inside the cell

B.text: to avoid unwanted digestion of proteins outside the cell

C.text: to catalyse digestion of proteins in the cytoplasm

D.text: to catalyse digestion of proteins in the rough endoplasmic reticulum
